newsitem.title: UK: Morgan Grenfell says fund redemptions lower.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Grenfell says fund redemptions lower.

text.p: Morgan Grenfell Asset Management, the London-based fund management unit of Deutsche Bank AG, said redemptions from its three beleagured European investment funds decreased to 24 million stg on Tuesday.
On Monday, 39 million stg was removed from the funds by investors. Tuesday's withdrawals take the total to some 256 million stg, ever nearer the 300 million stgt MGAM has to absorb redemptions.
The three funds temporarily stopped trading last week and two fund managers were suspended as a full-scale investigation got under way into possible irregularities in the way the funds have been run.
Deutsche Bank injected some 180 million stg of the 300 million redemption cushion by buying some unlisted securities, which were the original cause of the problem.
Industry sources have said Morgan Grenfell has come under some pressure from regulators to make clear how it intends to cover redemptions if they go above 300 million stg.

It has several options of which a loan by the parent bank, with the permission of the funds' trustees, looks like the safest bet given that a further injection of funds might worsen the dent already present in Deutsche's image.
